# Solaris CET

Solaris CET is a Romania-based company delivering:
- Photovoltaic (solar PV) installations (residential and industrial)
- Construction works
- Roofing (metal sheet / metal tiles / TPO membrane for industrial buildings)
- Metal parapets and facades
- Repairs and maintenance for all of the above
